facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 60°F at pass elevation.

avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left 3 nearby stations 15 to 32 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Potato Hill
evidence.detail: left May 17; earlier seasons: May 31 (2023), June 8 (2024), June 1 (2025)

evidence.name: Surprise Lakes
evidence.detail: left May 19; earlier seasons: June 19 (2023), June 20 (2024), June 12 (2025)

evidence.name: Pinto Rock
evidence.detail: left May 4; earlier seasons: June 6 (2023), June 5 (2024), June 1 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at all 3 nearby stations.

evidence.name: Potato Hill
evidence.detail: 18.8 in on April 3; earlier seasons: 39.7 in (2023), 33.9 in (2024), 37.1 in (2025)

evidence.name: Surprise Lakes
evidence.detail: 23.5 in on April 3; earlier seasons: 58.2 in (2023), 39.2 in (2024), 50.1 in (2025)

evidence.name: Pinto Rock
evidence.detail: 16.5 in on April 3; earlier seasons: 50.6 in (2023), 31.1 in (2024), 41.2 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 22 and June 6, carried from the melt-out dates at 3 nearby stations to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Potato Hill
evidence.detail: melted out May 17, 146 ft above the pass; points to April 22 to June 6

evidence.name: Surprise Lakes
evidence.detail: melted out May 19, 54 ft below the pass; points to April 28 to June 11

evidence.name: Pinto Rock
evidence.detail: melted out May 4, 116 ft above the pass; points to April 10 to May 24
